brief:
Besiktas supporters unfurled a pro-Palestinian banner during a UEFA Europa League match against Israeli club Hapoel Beer-Sheva in Georgia on Thursday, according to Al-Monitor. Police responded to the display, which triggered clashes and escalated into a diplomatic incident involving Turkey's foreign ministry.

The incident occurred as Besiktas faced Hapoel Beer-Sheva in a European competition fixture. The match and subsequent diplomatic fallout reflect broader tensions surrounding Israeli-Palestinian politics within international sports.
